source: User-authored AdventureParty_Fir_01 through 05, saved as SPM and FBX in the Adventure Party Development workspace. Bark and needle artwork supplied with the installed SpeedTree sample assets.
conversion: Blender FBX import, world Z-up to glTF Y-up, uniform normalization matching previous first fir height (724.35152 before runtime 0.18 scale). Separate opaque bark and alpha-mask needles; color and normal textures. Subsurface export retained in source workspace, not wired into the standard game material.
atlases: Five rows x twelve rotations; body 384x512 cells, shadow 512x512 cells. Top atlas five 256x256 cells. Production fir renderer used for body/shadow, no duplicate foliage meshes.
foliage: Original unstretched geometry restored; 1024px exports retained. Needle alpha 0.10 and premultipliedAlpha true for correct MSAA compositing.
